Hon'ble Vipin Sanghi, C.J. 
Hon’ble R.C. Khulbe, J.
 Mr. Mukesh Kumar Kaparuwan, learned counsel 
for the appellant. 
 Mr. S.S. Chaudhary, learned Brief Holder for 
the State of Uttarakhand. 
 Mr. Shashank Upadhyay, learned counsel for 
respondent No. 3. 
 Mr. T.A. Khan, learned Senior Counsel assisted 
by Mr. Mohd. Shafy, learned counsel for respondent 
No. 4. 
 After removing the appellants from the School 
of respondent No. 4, they have been got admitted 
to Mahendar Singh Memorial Public School. 
 We direct the appellants to file an affidavit 
disclosing the monthly fee and other expenses, 
which were payable to the respondent-School and 
which are payable to Mahendar Singh Memorial 
Public School for each year in respect of each of the 
appellant. The statement be filed in a tabulated 
form, along with a Supplementary Affidavit, within 
two weeks.   The respondents may also file Supplementary 
Affidavit(s) to bring on record the documents relied 
upon during the course of hearing before the 
learned Single Judge. 
 List on 21.02.2023. 
 (R.C. Khulbe, J) (Vipin Sanghi, CJ)
